name: Viscous Fallout
summary: In Gnomeregan's lower passages, Viscous Fallout drifts through the toxic runoff.

sections.title: A Polluted Spirit
sections.body: Radiation flooded Gnomeregan on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice, meant to wipe out the invading troggs. The fallout filled the city's lower levels with toxic slime and contamination. Viscous Fallout is a water elemental of those poisoned depths, its substance thick with the city's toxic waste. Its origins before the fall are unknown.

sections.title: Agony in the Runoff
sections.body: Viscous Fallout drifts through the irradiated lower passages as a living pool of toxic sludge. It spews volleys of toxin and lashes out at anything in its path. Those who enter Gnomeregan to cleanse its tainted depths must destroy the creature.

aliases: what kind of mob is viscous fallout
faq.answer: Viscous Fallout is a water elemental mini-boss inside Gnomeregan's ruined city, tainted by toxic sludge and radioactive fallout.

Radiation flooded Gnomeregan on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice to repel the trogg invasion, leaving the lower passages awash in toxic waste. No one knows exactly how the elemental came to be poisoned; it is part of the irradiated ruin the city has become.

faq.q: Where in Gnomeregan does it wander?
faq.answer: Viscous Fallout wanders the lower irradiated passages and runoff canals beneath Gnomeregan's main entry paths. It blends among the mutated slimes and toxic waste that infest the area.
Like much of what haunts the irradiated depths, Viscous Fallout lashes out at living creatures that trespass in the tainted passages.

faq.q: Does it have any connection to Ironforge?
faq.answer: The connection is indirect. Gnomes who fled Gnomeregan now live as refugees in Tinker Town inside Ironforge, while Viscous Fallout remains among the horrors in the home they lost.

faq.q: Can the elemental be cleansed or cured?
faq.answer: No cure is known for the elemental. Radiation and toxic chemicals have permeated its form so thoroughly that destroying it is the only answer.

angles.text: For gnomes, Viscous Fallout recalls the damage Mekgineer Thermaplugg inflicted on their home, where even the water runs toxic.
As a shaman, you can recognize a water elemental defiled by artificial toxic waste.
As a druid, you can see Viscous Fallout as a living wound upon nature, showing the harm reckless industry brings when contamination seeps into underground waters.
